'''Mike Fortner''' (born June 6, 1958) is a former [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] member of the [[Illinois House of Representatives]], representing the 49th district. He has also been a researcher at [[Fermilab]] since 1987, and a professor at [[Northern Illinois University]] since 1993. Before election to the House, he had been the [[Mayor]] of [[West Chicago, Illinois]].

On November 7, 2006, he defeated [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] candidate Dirk Enger, succeeding [[Randy Hultgren]], who was elected to the [[Illinois State Senate]] in the 48th district. He announced August 7, 2017, he would not seek reelection.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://capitolfax.com/2017/08/07/rep-fortner-to-retire-at-end-of-term/|title=Rep. Fortner to retire at end of term|last=Miller|first=Rich|newspaper=[[Capitol Fax]]|location=[[Springfield, Illinois]]|date=August 7, 2017|accessdate=August 7, 2017}}</ref> In the election to succeed Fortner, [[Karina Villa]] defeated DuPage County Board member Tonia Khouri.<ref>{{cite news|last=Krishnamurthy|first=Madhu|title=Villa wins handily in 49th House race|date=November 6, 2018|newspaper=[[Daily Herald (Arlington Heights)|Daily Herald]]|url=https://www.dailyherald.com/news/20181106/villa-wins-handily-in-49th-house-race}}</ref>

Fortner holds a Ph.D. in physics from [[Brandeis University]].<ref>[http://www.votesmart.org/bio.php?can_id=57446 Project Vote Smart - Representative Mike Fortner - Biography<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

House Minority Leader [[Jim Durkin]] appointed Fortner to the Census Advisory Panel for a term beginning June 25, 2019.<ref>{{cite web|editor-last=Klenke|editor-first=Clayton|title=Expiration and Vacancies Governor October 2019|page=33|date=October 31, 2019|accessdate=May 10, 2020|url= http://www.ilga.gov/commission/lru/Gov.pdf|publisher=State of Illinois Commission on Government Forecasting and Accountability|archive-url=<!--This will be necessary as the Commission updates use the same URL go to web.archive.org-->|archive-date=<!--This will be necessary as the Commission updates use the same URL web.archive.org-->}}</ref> The Census Advisory Panel advisory board to the Census Office within the Department of Human Services to ensure complete and accurate census count for the [[2020 United States Census]].<ref name="Task Force List">{{cite web|last=Gruber|first=Amanda|title=Publication 425: State Board and Commission Descriptions|publisher=State of Illinois Commission on Government Forecasting and Accountability|date=August 1, 2019|accessdate=May 10, 2020|page=52|url=http://www.ilga.gov/commission/lru/Descriptions.pdf|archive-url=<!--This will be necessary as the Commission updates use the same URL go to web.archive.org-->|archive-date=<!--This will be necessary as the Commission updates use the same URL web.archive.org-->}}</ref>
